name: MSP Account Management Report
description: Generates account-management reporting for MSP customer review workflows, starting with Microsoft 365 license summary data.

dataHandling.artifactSensitivity: Tenant user and license reporting data
dataHandling.notes: Outputs may include user display names, user principal names, account enabled state, assigned license products, tenant license counts, and account-management recommendations.

environment.name: CONTROL_PLANE_RUNTIME_TOKEN_URL
environment.description: Control plane endpoint used to exchange a job-scoped runtime token for live Microsoft Graph access.

environment.name: CONTROL_PLANE_RUNTIME_TOKEN
environment.description: Short-lived job-scoped broker token supplied by the control plane for runtime Microsoft Graph token exchange.

environment.name: GRAPH_ACCESS_TOKEN
environment.description: Legacy/local Microsoft Graph bearer token fallback. Local sample data is used when no Graph token source is available.

requiredPermissions.reason: Reads tenant organization metadata and subscribed SKU information for account-management reporting.
Reads user profile and assigned license data to identify licensed, unlicensed, and disabled licensed accounts.
Provides directory read coverage for tenant-level reporting where user and license relationships require directory context.
